name: chat
title: Chat agent
description: A focused, system-prompted chat agent. createPilotHandler on the server, <Pilot> + <PilotSidebar> on the client. Replace the system prompt with your agent's persona; mount the route + the React component into your existing app.

envVars.name: PILOT_MODEL
envVars.help: Model id (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5'). Defaults to openai/gpt-4o-mini if unset.

nextSteps: Mount the server handler in your existing Hono / Express / Next.js app:
Render the React component somewhere in your route tree:
Edit SYSTEM_PROMPT in server/{{NAME}}-agent.ts to match your agent's persona.
If unset, the agent uses openai/gpt-4o-mini. Set PILOT_MODEL in .env.local to change.
